detection.note: Competition tuned v2: STRICT yellow-only detection. H(20-30)=pure yellow, S(90+)=vivid saturation (rejects pale colors), V(60+)=visible brightness. Removed adaptive threshold. Selective saturation boost only in yellow hue range prevents false positives on other colors.

periodic_capture.note: Captures full-resolution images at regular intervals during mission

pixhawk.note: TELEM2 at 921600 baud (high-speed). Activates when GCS connects to TELEM1.

mavlink_detection.description: Hybrid detection transmission - Socket.IO primary + MAVLink fallback
mavlink_detection.note: Enables detection transmission over long-range MAVLink radio via Pixhawk to GCS. Messages forwarded from TELEM2 to TELEM1 automatically.
